title: The push argv check accepted the atomic flag and explicit lease followed by --no-atomic --no-force-with-lease
resolution: The whole push argv is compared with taskBranchPushArguments; cancelsAtomic and cancelsLease variants fail.

title: The argv secret check searched only the raw secret and missed the encoded Authorization header
resolution: sensitiveValues covers the secret, the authorization value, its credential part, and the base64 of each; passesHeaderInArguments fails.

title: A finding's diagnostic label repeated every argument, so it echoed the secret it found
resolution: Labels name the pid and operation and argv is redacted before formatting; tests prove no finding contains a credential.

title: Environment key names alone let an inherited GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL or GIT_CONFIG_KEY_n pass, and GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 was unchecked
resolution: Redacted environment values are observed and checked; inheritsGlobalConfig and inheritsConfigPairs fail.

title: plantGitSetting wrote invalid Git config under an existing [core] section
resolution: Settings are planted with git config --file --add, and a test lists them with the real Git parser.

title: A final config without planted settings did not prove they never acted, so an adapter that used and then removed them passed
resolution: Each observed process carries the .git/config it found at start; rewritesConfigAfterGit fails.

title: Non-UTF-8 paths and symlink targets were deferred to 16b though the string-typed snapshot API cannot carry them
resolution: Refused with non-utf8-path through decodeGitPath and isUtf8Text in the contract, spec, types, and tests.

title: The macOS reclaim requirement contradicted Git process identity, which required the reclaim program in its own containment
resolution: A full MODIFIED Git process identity distinguishes Linux and macOS.

title: The contract said every operation but list and sweep returns Result, missing handedOff
resolution: handedOff is listed with list and sweep, with its disk error behaviour.

title: The double's PAX parser split records on newline, cutting a long filename that contains one
resolution: Records are parsed by their byte length, with a regression test.

title: The double's archive reader lost a file named __proto__ by assigning into a plain object
resolution: Uses Object.create(null), with a regression test.
